files.status.json: optional runtime status; absent means disabled
files.thread-safety.json: optional receipt written only after seven checks pass

fields.name: string 1..80 (e.g. benny-triage)
fields.instructions: string 1..16000 natural-language live prompt; references committed operational paths, does not embed pack bodies
fields.operationalPath: optional repo-relative path string when automate confirms the file is committed

variants.notes: Reuse shape from RoutineSchema for make-bot continuity; separate store from pstack-routines until a later migrate unit

fields.tools: string[] capability labels (slack.thread.read, slack.thread.reply, tracker, repo, pr.create, controlAdapter)
fields.kind: literal disabled on prepare and on editor save
fields.revision: sha256 of canonical JSON without automationId/kind

disabledUntilThreadSafety.rule: AutomationEnable refuses unless thread-safety.json records all seven checks for this revision
disabledUntilThreadSafety.creationBoundary: first-time finish path stops at editor save with kind=disabled
